title: 第5章分别
slug: 斗罗开局被逼入赘对象宁荣荣
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

此刻，宁风致甚至能感受到一股若有若无的杀气从江蓠身上弥漫开来。

那杀气并不浓烈，甚至算不上凛冽。

但它无比纯粹。

感受到这股不经意间散发的杀意，宁风致脸上的笑容缓缓收敛。

沉默了片刻，给火堆加了几根干柴后，这才缓缓说道。

“前两年去庚辛城的时候，我见过他，那时候的他已经突破了六十级，这么久过去了，他的修为应该早就稳固。”

“而你，不过才刚刚突破魂帝，单枪匹马去他的地盘杀他，有些太过冒险了，不如先跟我回宗门巩固一下修为，等过段时间再去也不迟。“

江蓠的神色却是没有丝毫的变化。

“我已经等了十几年了。”

声音不大，语气也很平淡。

但就是这种平淡，反而比咬牙切齿更让人心惊。

那不是愤怒，而是理智之后做出的抉择。

宁风致看着她的眼睛，许久，轻轻叹了口气。

“既然如此——”思虑了片刻，宁风致深吸了口气，这才对着江蓠说道。

“行吧，注意安全。”

古榕不由一愣，张了张嘴，想说什么，但看到宁风致的眼神，又闭上了。

他了解这个男人——看似温和，实则一旦做了决定，旁人根本劝不回来。

“既然如此……行吧。”

一夜无眠，天刚蒙蒙亮，三人便已启程。

想了一晚上，江蓠也后悔了一晚上。

大意了，她当时发誓应该只用其中一个武魂来着，现在好了，如果宁荣荣真的看上自己了，那自己该怎么收场啊。

正想着，只感觉胸口微微有些刺痛，低头一看，蛛儿不知何时爬了出来，只露了一个小脑袋，那看自己的眼神甚至带着一抹委屈。

“蛛儿，你别这样，我指的是那个武魂，没说你，我们的感情你知道的，相依为命这么多年，我怎么舍得让你灰飞烟灭呢。”

“好了，快回去，别闹了。”

尽管声若蚊蝇，但蛛儿却是听清了一般，目光幽怨的瞪了一眼江蓠，这才不情不愿的缩了回去。

这一幕，宁风致两人看在了眼中，对视一眼，苦笑一笑。

Page (1/3)

At this moment, Ning Fengzhi could even feel a faint murderous aura spreading from Jiang Li's body.

The murderous aura was not strong, not even harsh.

But it's incredibly pure.

Feeling this inadvertent killing intent, the smile on Ning Fengzhi's face slowly faded.

After a moment of silence and adding a few dry firewood to the fire, he spoke slowly.

"I met him when I went to Gengxin City two years ago. At that time, he had already broken through level 60. After so long, his cultivation should have been stable."

"As for you, you have just broken through the Soul Emperor. Going to his territory to kill him single-handedly is a bit too risky. Why don't you go back to the sect with me to consolidate your cultivation first? It won't be too late to go after a while."

Jiang Li's expression did not change at all.

"I've been waiting for more than ten years."

His voice was not loud and his tone was very calm.

But this kind of plainness is more frightening than gritting one's teeth.

That was not anger, but a rational decision.

Ning Fengzhi looked into her eyes for a long time and sighed softly.

"In that case -" After thinking for a moment, Ning Fengzhi took a deep breath and then said to Jiang Li.

"Okay, be safe."

Gu Rong couldn't help but was stunned. He opened his mouth and wanted to say something, but when he saw Ning Fengzhi's eyes, he closed it again.

He knew this man - he seemed gentle, but in fact once he made a decision, no one else could persuade him to come back.

"In that case...okay."

After a sleepless night, the three of them set off at dawn.

After thinking about it all night, Jiang Li also regretted it all night.

She was careless. She swore at the time that she should only use one of the spirits. Now it's fine. If Ning Rongrong really fell in love with her, how would she end it?

Just as he was thinking about it, he felt a slight sting in his chest. When he lowered his head, he saw that Zhu Er had crawled out at some point, with only a small head exposed. The look he looked at himself even contained a hint of grievance.

"Zhu'er, don't be like this. I'm referring to that martial soul, not you. You know our feelings. We have been dependent on each other for so many years. How can I be willing to let you disappear into ashes?"

"Okay, go back quickly and stop making trouble."

Although the sound was like that of a mosquito or a fly, the spider seemed to hear it clearly and glared at Gracilaria with a resentful look before reluctantly shrinking back.

Ning Fengzhi and the two saw this scene, looked at each other, and smiled bitterly.
